title: GLM-5.2 is probably the most powerful text-only open weights LLM
description: Chinese AI lab Z.ai released GLM-5.2, a 744B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with ~40B active parameters per token and a 1 million token context window (up from GLM-5.1's 200,000). Released under MIT license on June 16, 2026, described as 'built for long-horizon tasks.'
author: Simon Willison

title: AI demands more engineering discipline, not less
description: Quote from Charity Majors highlighted by Simon Willison: 'What happened in 2025 was this: the economics of code production were turned upside down. Instead of being very hard, time-consuming, and expensive to generate code, it became effectively free and instant. Lines of code went from being treasured, reused, cared for and carefully curated, to being disposable and regenerable, practically overnight.'
author: Simon Willison (quoting Charity Majors)
